# Acme

> Acme is a project management tool for agencies and client-service teams. Plans start at
> $12 per user per month; a 14-day trial is available. This file lists the pages that best
> answer common questions about Acme.

Facts on this site are current as of October 2026. Prices are in USD unless stated.

## Product

- [What Acme is and who it's for](https://www.example.com/about): one-page overview and company facts
- [Pricing](https://www.example.com/pricing): plans, limits and what each includes
- [Features](https://www.example.com/features): client portals, time tracking, workload planning
- [Integrations](https://www.example.com/integrations): Slack, Google Drive, HubSpot and more

## Comparisons

- [Acme vs alternatives](https://www.example.com/compare): honest comparison with the main alternatives

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://docs.example.com/start): setup in under 15 minutes
- [API reference](https://docs.example.com/api): REST API and webhooks

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://www.example.com/changelog): release notes by date
- [Security and compliance](https://www.example.com/security): SOC 2, data residency, SSO
